nom: HERBIVORE AQUARIUS BHA + Blue Tansy Clarity Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and less oil production during the day, some using it as a double-cleanse step and finding it doesn't over-strip.
segments.dry: Reviewers note the cleanser does not dry out or flake their skin, leaving it soft rather than tight, though one dry/combo reviewer found it slightly tightening without being dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as gentle enough not to be drying while still controlling excess oil in warmer months or T-zone areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some prone to eczema or redness, report no irritation and describe it as gentle, calming, and non-stripping.
segments.mature: A few reviewers in their 40s-60s report smoother texture and improved skin appearance with regular use, without dryness.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer (45) reports smoother, softer skin; another (52) reports no new breakouts over six months; effects on visible aging itself are not described in detail.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report the cleanser does not dry out or strip skin, with several noting improved hydration or softness after use; one reviewer experienced mild flaking/purging when starting.
concerns.redness: Reviewers describe reduced redness and calming effects, including for a teen's acne-related redness and for reviewers with sensitive, irritation-prone skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and balancing rather than harsh, with one reviewer citing it as gentler than eczema-specific products; one reviewer reported mild flaking/purging initially.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fewer blackheads, reduced pore congestion, and smaller-looking pores within one to several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including those with hormonal, cystic, or teen acne, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within one to several weeks; a minority report new breakouts, cystic pimples, or purging when starting, and one reviewer stopped using it after it caused breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report visibly less oil and a matte, clean feeling after use, with some specifically pairing it with oil-control routines.

extraits.texte: I'm begging companies to STOP doing this. I have been purchasing this cleanser for years. It was my favorite cleanser! I bought a new one and the packaging was different and I was suspicious. Once I smelled it I could tell they changed something but I decided to try it and it burned my face! I googled it and on a surface level everything says they haven't changed the formula but I went onto a Time Machine site to look at the product page to compare ingredients and as expected they have overhauled the formula. You can guess why. The ingredients are cheaper. So disappointed :(

I picked this up on a whim and I'm not sure why, because I have very sensitive skin and trying new products historically has done me more harm than good. I used tret in the past but could never get past the sensitivity that came with it. I decided to try a more active cleanser for my redness and irritation prone combo skin, and this product literally gave my face ten years back. I did experience some mild flaking and purging in the beginning, but I did not lose hope. After about a month of consistent use I have radiant skin for the first time in my life in my 30s. I will repurchase this into the next lifetime.

extraits.titre: LOVE! - from an Oily Cystic Ance Prone Gal!
extraits.texte: I'm hooked! My skin is very sensitive to breakouts with any changes to my skin care routine. When I do break out it is typically cystic. I introduced this cleanser into my routine for just my evening wash to start, and I had a very very mild breakout (2-3 zits) that didn't last very long. I am pleased to say that's already cleared up and my skin has been looking pretty clear, even after going on a weekend trip - I ALWAYS break out after traveling! But I'm still in the clear! (Pun intended) I also love the feeling of the cleanser. I do a double cleanse whenever I wash my face. The first wash with the Aquarius cleanser (I use 2 pumps, I'm an oily girl!!) got the first layer off and didn't feel like much at first, but the second cleanse (another 2 pumps) it gets a nice gentle foam and I can feel it getting a deeper clean! I also personally love the Blue Tansy face mask, so I love the scent of the cleanser as well! All around really happy with this product!

I highly recommend the Aquarius Clarity Cleanser! It makes my skin feel fresh & clean & does not feel tight & dry as some facial cleaners do. I have sensitive skin with occasional breakouts around my nose & chin area, & while using this cleanser I'm seeing great results. I am in my mid 60's so have tried many cleansers over the years.

This is very luxurious. The texture is almost gel like, not too thick and not too thin. It lathers nicely. It left my skin feeling very soft and very clean but not stripped at all. I have combo dry skin and this worked out perfectly for me.
This one is part of my nighttime routine. I've been using it for over 6 mos and I haven't had one single pimple come up. Smells good and feels refreshing. 52yo with medium skin.
Broke me out. But i like the smell and was able to take my makeup off decently well.
